name: CardStack
job: Show a pile of cards (testimonials or highlights) where the front card moves to the back to reveal the next
visitor_action: drag/swipe the front card away, or click it; arrow keys; auto-advances on a timer, pauses on hover/focus
mobile: touch-swipe, full width, stack depth reduced
motion: spring-driven card fly-off and re-stack with depth parallax (reduced-motion: crossfade only, static stack)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Alpine morning: pale sky-to-porcelain stage with soft cloud light, frosted ice-glass cards with crisp top highlight and cool shadows, ink-navy type, one cobalt accent, subtle grain
